definitions.explanation: The year before the current one. A somewhat formal alternative to 去年 (きょねん).

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}は{大変|たいへん}な{年|とし}だった。
examples.english: Last year was a tough year.

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}の{売上|うりあげ}は{前年|ぜんねん}より{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Last year's sales increased compared to the year before.

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}の{夏|なつ}、{家族|かぞく}で{北海道|ほっかいどう}に{旅行|りょこう}した。
examples.english: Last summer, our family traveled to Hokkaido.

notes:
{昨年|さくねん} is a formal synonym of {去年|きょねん} (last year). Both mean the same thing, but {昨年|さくねん} is preferred in writing, news, business reports, and formal speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {昨年|さくねん}: last year (formal, written, news)
- {去年|きょねん}: last year (conversational, everyday)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昨年|さくねん}{度|ど}: last fiscal year
- {昨年|さくねん}{比|ひ}: compared to last year
- {昨年|さくねん}{末|まつ}: the end of last year
- {昨年|さくねん}{同期|どうき}: the same period last year

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {一昨年|おととし}/{一昨年|いっさくねん}: the year before last (informal/formal)
- {今年|ことし}: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year
- {前年|ぜんねん}: the previous year (used in comparisons)
